items.title: How Agent Anomaly Detection scores on benchmarks we didn't write
items.summary: Agent Anomaly Detection (AAD) provides asynchronous, low-latency monitoring for AI agents by analyzing OpenTelemetry traces and logs to flag goal hijacks and tool misuse. Tested across five public security benchmarks, AAD successfully caught 87% of harmful instructions carried out by agents without adding runtime latency. Developers can integrate AAD alongside semantic governance and strict tool limits as part of a defense-in-depth strategy to secure agentic applications.
